purpose: Freeze a synthetic IEEE-39 operating-point stress ensemble and its 1,000 immutable scenario IDs before any IAS26-060B PF/DAE/eigenvalue evaluation.
scientific_question: Does the H4 minimal-blocker pattern, and does the fixed preregistered g=0.25 retuning, persist under the declared synthetic IEEE-39 operating-point stress envelope?

scope_and_claim_limits.no_M1_reduced_root_comparison: IAS26-010 remains BLOCKED_M1_STRICT; all IAS26-060 stability metrics are direct-DAE transverse spectra.
scope_and_claim_limits.thermal_security_claim: Not available: the frozen IEEE-39 network JSON contains no branch thermal ratings, so this campaign can screen generator and bus-voltage feasibility but not thermal loading or N-1 security.

uncertainty_contract_reuse.audit: Reviewed the IAS26 BND-H4 campaign tickets/configs and searched the project research contracts for an identical joint load-scale, base-load-weighted spatial perturbation, and active redispatch law; no semantically identical contract was found. Other project uncertainty studies have different systems/variables and are not reused.

system.bus_voltage_setpoints: Frozen IEEE-39 PV v0 values; unchanged across scenarios and treatments.
system.paired_case_policy: All 16 portfolios use the same scenario P_L/Q_L and generator P schedules at g=0.03625; one additional H4 all-GFL case uses the same scenario inputs at g=0.25. No other parameter or model change.

base_case_snapshot.units: p.u. on 100-MVA system base unless a field explicitly says MVA

rng.stream_order: For each ID in ascending order draw one load-scale uniform, then draw 19 epsilon uniforms per proposal until the predeclared centered-support condition is satisfied.

spatial_epsilon.raw_component_law: independent zero-mean truncated Gaussian; its population standard deviation after scalar truncation and before weighted centering is exactly 0.025 pu
spatial_epsilon.final_hard_support_rule: Accept the raw vector only if every weighted-centered component is within [-0.05,+0.05] pu; otherwise draw a new epsilon proposal for the same scenario ID. No clipping or rescaling. Every accepted and rejected raw uniform/epsilon proposal is stored in that ID's CSV row.
spatial_epsilon.dependence_note: Weighted centering and support-conditioned acceptance induce dependence across load buses. The 0.025 pu standard deviation describes the raw scalar truncated-Gaussian components before centering; final centered sample distributions are reported descriptively and are not rescaled.

load_transform.power_factor: Preserve each signed base Q_L,i,0/P_L,i,0 exactly at every bus; no aggregate Q redistribution.

scenario_generation.sampling_rejection_scope: Only the predeclared epsilon hard-support condition after weighted centering; never a PF, feasibility, DAE, eigenvalue, stability, or portfolio outcome. Scenario IDs are assigned before sampling and are never dropped or replaced.

redispatch.unit_set_rule: All nine scheduled non-slack PV generator buses in the frozen IEEE-39 source; this includes the H4 plant sites so station-level dispatch is identical across every replacement subset and both g treatments. Slack bus 39 is excluded.
redispatch.base_participation_factor: beta_i = P_G,i,0 / sum_j(P_G,j,0), using only the frozen base scheduled active generation p0 of the declared participant units; no stability or eigenvalue information.
redispatch.required_total_active_redispatch: delta_P_G,total = sum_i(P_L,i,s - P_L,i,0); equals (L_s-1)*sum_i(P_L,i,0) up to floating-point centering error.
redispatch.allocation_rule: Allocate the remaining delta using the original beta_i among unsaturated units. Clamp any proposed unit schedule crossing its frozen pmin/pmax to that bound, subtract its delivered increment, then iteratively redistribute the remainder among the still-unsaturated units using their original base-P weights renormalized. Bus-order tie handling is ascending bus number. No cost objective, stability-informed weighting, or post-hoc reallocation.
redispatch.active_limits_source: Frozen IEEE-39 PV pmin/pmax fields on 100-MVA system base.
redispatch.if_total_capacity_is_insufficient: Retain the scenario ID and the clipped schedules; flag REDISPATCH_CAPACITY_SHORTFALL and classify it physically infeasible for the primary outcome. Never drop or replace it.

baseline_arithmetic_capacity_check.note: Aggregate active redispatch capacity exceeds the maximum requested load-scale change before accounting for the power-flow residual; individual saturation is handled by the frozen iterative rule.

slack_policy.role: Conventional AC power-flow swing/slack bus at frozen voltage magnitude and angle; it may absorb only the real/reactive mismatch left by the frozen power-flow equations, including network losses.
slack_policy.p_schedule: No scenario-dependent P setpoint is assigned to the slack bus.
slack_policy.reactive_and_apparent_limit: No independent slack Q limits are present in the frozen JSON; enforce the source machine nameplate apparent-power circle P_slack^2+Q_slack^2 <= (1199/100)^2 pu^2, with P bounds above.
slack_policy.if_residual_exceeds_limits: PF case is physically infeasible; no slack clipping, rebalancing, or scenario replacement.

physical_feasibility.load_power_factor: Exact signed bus-specific base Q/P ratio retained.
physical_feasibility.generator_active_power: Each PV generator schedule must satisfy source pmin/pmax, including the deterministic redispatch participants.
physical_feasibility.generator_reactive_power: At each non-slack PV bus, solved net generator Q must satisfy source qmin/qmax. Q is not separately redispatched; a violation invalidates the case rather than silently changing bus type or clipping Q.
physical_feasibility.plant_apparent_power: At every scheduled PV generator/plant bus, P_G^2+Q_G^2 <= (Sn/100 MVA)^2 in pu units. Apply the same plant-level nameplate check to partial SG/GFL shares using aggregate bus injection.
physical_feasibility.slack_apparent_power: As specified by slack_policy using source Sn=1199 MVA.

bus_voltage_pu.origin: Explicit synthetic engineering screening envelope; these limits are not supplied by the frozen IEEE-39 JSON.

physical_feasibility.branch_thermal_limits: Not screened because the frozen network file has no branch MVA/current ratings. No thermal, contingency, or full operational-security claim is allowed.
physical_feasibility.scenario_outcome_validity: A scenario is complete/valid for primary proportions only if all 16 original portfolios and the paired H4 g=0.25 case have converged PF/DAE, satisfy every available declared physical limit, and return finite full transverse spectra with accepted eigenpair residuals. Invalid IDs remain in the all-ID denominator bounds and are separately reported.
physical_feasibility.metric_specific_missing_band: A complete finite full spectrum with no admissible 0.3-1.5 Hz alpha_Omega mode remains valid for alpha_perp; alpha_Omega is recorded unavailable with ALPHA_OMEGA_BAND_MISSING.

power_flow.acceptance: root.success is true AND max absolute AC mismatch < 1e-9 pu
power_flow.initialization: Frozen source bus voltage magnitudes, zero non-slack initial angles and frozen slack angle; deterministic, no load continuation or alternate initial guesses.
power_flow.retry_policy: No retry with a changed tolerance, initial guess, solver, or scenario draw. A failure is retained under its original ID.

dae_equilibrium.residual_norm: infinity norm, matching the IAS26-050 nominal check

eigenvalues.matrix: Complete direct-DAE transverse operator A_perp; compute every transverse eigenvalue, no target-band-only truncation or reduced roots.
eigenvalues.solver: numpy.linalg.eig on the dense real A_perp, matching the frozen F1/IAS26-050 implementation.
eigenvalues.alpha_perp: max(real(lambda)) over the complete finite transverse spectrum.
eigenvalues.alpha_Omega: Separately report the rightmost positive-frequency transverse eigenvalue in 0.3-1.5 Hz, using the frozen TX4 selector: imag(lambda)>=-1e-10 rad/s, frequency boundary tolerance 1e-10 Hz, and abs(lambda)>1e-3 s^-1. If none exists, mark unavailable; never substitute it for alpha_perp.

case_execution.per_scenario_order: Frozen 16 portfolio_ids_in_frozen_F1_order at g=0.03625, followed by H4 all-GFL at g=0.25.
case_execution.continue_after_case_failure: Continue remaining cases in fixed order where execution infrastructure is alive; record each case outcome/failure independently. A process-wide abort leaves every unstarted case explicitly unrun under its original scenario ID.

mode_tracking.purpose: Diagnostic only; never changes alpha_perp, stability classification, feasibility, or primary event gates.
mode_tracking.original_reference: Complete nominal IAS26-020 F1 eigenpairs, matched by the same portfolio_id at g=0.03625.
mode_tracking.retuned_reference: Complete nominal IAS26-050 H4 g=0.25 eigenpairs.
mode_tracking.comparison_space: Right eigenvectors in the transverse quotient. Align reference/current transverse bases by Q=Z_current^T Z_reference; only compare if state layout and quotient subspace match, with relative Frobenius alignment residual <=1e-10. Otherwise mark MODE_TRACKING_NOT_COMPARABLE.
mode_tracking.mac: Phase-invariant normalized right-eigenvector MAC = |v_ref^H v_current|^2/((v_ref^H v_ref)(v_current^H v_current)); use one representative per conjugate family (imag>=0), and compare the reference critical family against every current eigenfamily.
mode_tracking.mode_family_dominance: Track the reference critical family to its best-MAC current eigenfamily and report its eigenvalue plus alpha_perp-real(lambda_tracked). It remains dominant only if that gap <=1e-6 s^-1.
mode_tracking.unresolved_rule: If MAC threshold, score margin, layout, or basis alignment fails, report identity unresolved; do not claim the H4 mode moved or disappeared based on this diagnostic.

primary_scenario_quantities.x_s: max alpha_perp,s(R) over all 15 strict subsets R of H4 from the frozen 16-portfolio lattice, original g=0.03625
primary_scenario_quantities.m_s: min(y_s,-x_s), signed H4 minimal-blocker margin in s^-1
primary_scenario_quantities.alpha_perp_original: y_s, complete transverse spectral abscissa at g=0.03625
primary_scenario_quantities.alpha_perp_intervention: complete transverse spectral abscissa for H4 all-GFL at g=0.25
primary_scenario_quantities.delta_alpha_s: alpha_perp_intervention - alpha_perp_original; negative is movement left.
primary_scenario_quantities.alpha_Omega: Record separately for every portfolio/treatment where the target-band mode exists.

H4_MINIMAL_BLOCKER_PERSISTS.true: All 15 proper-subset alpha_perp values are < -tau_dec AND original H4 alpha_perp y_s > +tau_dec; equivalently x_s < -tau_dec and y_s > +tau_dec.
H4_MINIMAL_BLOCKER_PERSISTS.false: All required cases are valid/determinate and the conjunction is false.
H4_MINIMAL_BLOCKER_PERSISTS.indeterminate: Any required case is invalid or any required alpha_perp lies in [-tau_dec,+tau_dec].

PHENOMENON_PERSISTS.true: Within the censused 16 portfolios, at least one non-singleton portfolio S (cardinality 2-4) is unstable (alpha_perp>+tau_dec) and every strict subset T<S in the same lattice is stable (alpha_perp<-tau_dec); this includes the H4 event above and can include a different minimal blocker.
PHENOMENON_PERSISTS.false: All 16 original cases are valid/determinate and no such non-singleton inclusion-minimal unstable portfolio exists.
PHENOMENON_PERSISTS.indeterminate: The required lattice is incomplete/invalid or threshold-indeterminate cases prevent either conclusion.
PHENOMENON_PERSISTS.scope: Only the frozen V4 family is censused; no global minimality claim outside those 16 portfolios.

INTERVENTION_RESCUES_H4.true: Paired original H4 is unstable (alpha_perp_original>+tau_dec) AND paired g=0.25 H4 is stable (alpha_perp_intervention<-tau_dec), with both cases valid/feasible.
INTERVENTION_RESCUES_H4.false: Both paired cases are valid/determinate and the conjunction is false.
INTERVENTION_RESCUES_H4.indeterminate: Either case is invalid or either relevant alpha_perp is in the decision deadband.

INTERVENTION_IMPROVES_H4.indeterminate: The paired full-spectrum values are not both valid/finite.

event_definitions.OTHER_MINIMAL_BLOCKER_EXISTS: At least one non-singleton inclusion-minimal unstable S != H4 exists within the frozen V4 lattice; report separately from H4_MINIMAL_BLOCKER_PERSISTS.

failure_taxonomy.no_retry_or_replacement: Every original scenario_id and portfolio/treatment cell receives a result or its explicit failure/unrun code. No new random scenario is substituted. ALPHA_OMEGA_BAND_MISSING affects only the secondary metric if the full spectrum is valid.

statistical_analysis.unit_of_analysis: scenario_id (the 16 original portfolios and paired retuned H4 remain a cluster)

wilson_95.conditional_denominator: Numerically complete, physically feasible, and determinate scenario IDs for the event being estimated.
wilson_95.conservative_all_id_bounds: For N=1000 and k known-true among d determinate valid IDs, report [k/N,(k+N-d)/N], treating all unknown/invalid/indeterminate IDs as failures for the lower bound and possible successes for the upper bound.
wilson_95.invalid_and_indeterminate_rates: Report separately for every event denominator.

scenario_level_bootstrap.method: Nonparametric percentile bootstrap of complete scenario IDs; resample all paired outcomes/portfolios/treatments belonging to an ID together.
scenario_level_bootstrap.reported_margin_statistics: For x_s, y_s, m_s, and paired delta_alpha_s, report median and q05/q25/q75/q95; bootstrap percentile intervals for the median and each reported quantile on complete valid determinate scenario clusters. Also report missing/invalid counts and the all-ID conservative proportion bounds; no imputation.

statistical_analysis.interpretation: All empirical proportions describe only this declared synthetic ensemble; never call them real-world event probabilities.

prerun_outputs.pre_run_scope: The manifest and its input-distribution/redispatch summary are generated before any perturbed power flow, DAE, Jacobian, or eigenvalue solve.

source_provenance.dirty_state_note: The repository already had unrelated, uncommitted IAS26-010/020/030/050 artifacts. Every scientific source/data dependency below is individually SHA256-pinned; no unrelated changes were staged or overwritten.
